Leech.accuracy: one naturally flattened annelid body with fine ring segments and a sucker at each real terminal end; no invented limbs or facial eyes
Leech.layout: One complete adult leech in a shallow natural looping arch, right anterior and left posterior, with no coil, crossing or overlap. Preserve its flattened ribbon body, fine real annuli and two actual terminal suckers; both sucker rims and their connections are visible from a shallow side view. The anterior sucker is naturally smaller than the posterior. No earthworm clitellum, vertebrate face, eyes, legs, antennae or props. Keep actual skin markings and moist smooth material.

Sea Squirt.accuracy: one adult attached ascidian with its real basal tissue, translucent tunic, internal basket and two distinct siphons; no invented head, eyes or limbs
Sea Squirt.layout: One natural barrel-shaped solitary sea squirt, upright in a shallow three-quarter view. Retain both real raised nozzle siphons at the top, visibly separate with their own rims and openings, the leathery translucent tunic and faint internal basket. Show its genuine basal attachment tissue without rock, seabed or fabricated pedestal. A coarse template may have one aperture chain: that is not permission to hide or delete the second real siphon. No mouth face, eyes, animal limbs, new tentacles or extra zooids.

Banana Slug.accuracy: one natural shellless slug with a continuous muscular foot, head and mantle, two upper eye-bearing tentacles and two shorter sensory tentacles, real mouth fold and breathing opening
Banana Slug.layout: One whole bright yellow banana slug in right-facing shallow side view. Preserve the naturally shellless long slimy body, continuous broad muscular foot and complete lower sole edge. Both actual upper ocular tentacles are independently visible with their eye tips; show the two true shorter lower sensory tentacles and the small real mouth fold below the head. Show the real breathing hole on the mantle saddle. Preserve its natural mantle/body connection and tapered posterior; no shell, legs, duplicated stalks, snake face or large cartoon eyes.

Prawn.accuracy: one real prawn with five pairs of thoracic walking legs, natural abdominal swimmerets, two long antennae and shorter antennules, stalked eyes, rostrum and complete tail fan; no anatomical deletion
Prawn.layout: One natural prawn in right-facing shallow three-quarter side view, slightly elevated so both rows of its actual five walking-leg pairs are visible through their real roots and joints to their endpoints. Keep all ten walking-leg silhouettes as far as the natural viewpoint permits without inventing or relocating limbs. Retain every real short antennule, both very long antennae, the abdominal swimmerets, the six-section abdomen and intact tail fan. These fine swimming and sensory structures are real and must not be erased to fit a coarse rig. Preserve its toothed rostrum, stalked black eyes and translucent segmented carapace; no giant lobster pincers.

Crab.accuracy: one true crab with broad carapace, four actual walking-leg pairs, two real claws, two eye stalks and mouthparts; no visible vertebrate tail or extra legs
Crab.layout: One ordinary true crab in a slightly elevated front three-quarter view showing the broad flat carapace and all four actual walking legs on each side as eight distinct connected root/bend/tip paths. Both genuine claws project forward without covering the walking feet; show each claw arm base and elbow, palm, fixed finger and movable dactyl around its true hinge, slightly open. Both short eye stalks remain visible above the actual mouthparts. Do not substitute the gross male-fiddler asymmetry for this ordinary crab, add appendages, infer concealed last legs or invent a vertebrate tail. Preserve the tucked biological abdomen and real chitin surface.
